summary: Runs a @keyframes animation on the element, by name.
details: Shorthand for the keyframes name, duration, timing function, delay, iteration count, direction and fill mode. The name refers to a @keyframes rule elsewhere in the CSS that lists the steps (from/to or percentages). Unlike a transition, it needs no state change to start.

values.note: Play @keyframes fade-in once when the element appears.
Loop @keyframes spin forever at constant speed.

gotcha: The @keyframes rule must exist with exactly that name, or nothing happens. Respect people who ask for less motion: turn decorative animations off inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
